test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, LOCAL is written as MADOM and GLOBAL is written as HMACOM. How will ROMAN be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4dcdee4dc9c4f4c09120ac180ef530c5fb4eaf0f1d74e2ee08e170bf80dd9d8.png] 

 
• **Consonants are increased + 1.**
 
• Here 'O' is written as 'A'.
 
• Here 'A' is written as 'O'.

LOCAL is written as MADOM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aff4ef0bde796b974fe089d6e1da4d7023f2a19ce7c66a5bd7d9e0854d25beaa.png] 

and,

 
• GLOBAL is written as HMACOM.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e03f674f8f0c9178da1e02044925afdb6cc02368028b1b11a16ce8467f3ea59d.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **ROMAN will be written as :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f8e474629634f9aa88cbd7242d55dd1570a0c5afb6d4e69e153d78d160993b2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SANOO".**
